inputs.n: Odd public integer n>=3; original RSA target specializes to n=pq for distinct odd primes
inputs.transcript: Nonempty finite units x_i and positive Delta_i with x_i^Delta_i=1 mod n; invalid input rejected
inputs.public_derived: L=lcm Delta_i=2^s*u with u odd, y_i=x_i^u; repeated squaring determines exact dyadic orders
not_supplied: factorization of the odd part u

antecedent_match.parameter_map: paper prime parameter=2; a=maximal-order supplied y_j; b=y_i; depths computed publicly
antecedent_match.required_extra_output_check: Cyclicity alone is weaker than injectivity of every CRT projection. Check a generator half-power equals global -1, unless subgroup trivial.
antecedent_match.root_witness_format: For dyadic digit failure after global half-power check, retain the square-root residual w and gcd(w-1,n). Not guaranteed by an arbitrary black-box factor-only implementation.

outputs: proper divisor 1<d<n, with nontrivial square-root witness if the dyadic residual is retained
trivial group certificate, or explicit y_i=g^e_i with g^(2^(t-1))=-1; every prime-power CRT projection injective
paid_costs: odd stripping exponentiation of bitlength O(log L)
exact order detection at most r*s squarings
limits: positive certificate is not primality proof
does not constrain newly added generators
does not replace formal current Task/owner authorization
external classical modular arithmetic; no native X6 physical lift

paper_examples: n=15, K=<4> cyclic but projection modulo3 noninjective
n=45, z=19 gives gcd(18,45)=9 proper composite divisor
n=9, (x,Delta)=(2,6), stripped y=8 gives positive dyadic certificate
